_comment: Ground-truth expected image counts per article. Drop the matching .htm file into test/fixtures/ (gitignored to avoid redistributing copyrighted article HTML) and run `npm test`. Add entries here to extend the suite.

cases._comment: Committed synthetic fixture: KaTeX inline + display, MathJax v3 assistive MathML, MathJax v2 script pair, raw Wikipedia-style MathML. 5 math placeholders, no photos.
Committed synthetic fixture (real page is behind an anti-bot wall): ztext-math wrappers hydrated/unhydrated/display + bare equation?tex img. Guards against the duplicated-TeX-text bug.

Real saved Zhihu page (unhydrated ztext-math spans: TeX as inner text + data-tex attr). 249 occurrences dedup to 195. Regression-guards the pass-2 fallback: TeX fallback text is 83% of the article, which used to trip the degradation guard and drop every marker.
WordPress.com WP-LaTeX: 102 s0.wp.com/latex.php formula s deduping to 49 unique (TeX from alt). Before math support, assetKey collapsed all of them to one image.
